description: This file defines the interface IAppManager in the WPEFramework project within the Exchange namespace. It declares the IAppManager interface, which includes nested notification interface and several methods for managing applications such as launching, loading, closing, setting properties, and managing app states. It also defines an associated iterator type and various notifications related to app lifecycle events.

classes.name: IAppManager
classes.description: Interface for managing applications, including notifications, application lifecycle management, and property settings.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for application lifecycle events such as installation, uninstallation, state changes, and launch requests.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification listener for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification listener.

methods.name: GetLaunchableApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of launchable applications.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently loaded applications.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launches an application with specified intent and arguments.

methods.name: LoadApp
methods.description: Loads an application with specified intent and arguments.

methods.name: PrepareApp
methods.description: Prepares an application for launching.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to an application.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes a specified application.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminates a specified application.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clears data for a specified application.

methods.name: SetAppFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specified application.

methods.name: GetAppMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific application.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value for an application.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Sets a property for an application.

methods.name: SetMaxInactiveApps
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of inactive apps allowed.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveApps
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of inactive apps allowed.

methods.name: SetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: SetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Sets the maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Gets the maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: SetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Sets the maximum RAM usage for inactive apps.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Gets the maximum RAM usage for inactive apps.

ctags.name: INotification
